app_info.subtitle: PDF Invoices & Contracts
app_info.description: Create and preview PDF invoices, estimates, receipts, contracts, non-disclosure agreements, and real estate documents from the details you provide. Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

authentication.instructions: Document generation is available without credentials. When customer sync is enabled, generation can update customer records and start automated follow-up as described in the privacy policy.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a PDF and, when customer sync is enabled, sends contact details and a document summary to Pressmark's customer records. It can update an opportunity and enroll the contact in follow-up workflows.
justifications.destructive_justification: Customer sync can replace existing contact fields and update an existing opportunity's stage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Configured customer sync sends records to Pressmark's external HighLevel account. Repeated calls can repeat updates and workflow enrollment attempts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renders a PNG preview; each call produces a new preview artifact.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns a preview without deleting or overwriting documents.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access external web resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes totals from supplied values; no stored records or external systems involved.
justifications.destructive_justification: Calculates totals without changing stored records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access external web resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the review status of one feedback report; changes nothing.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reads status without changing stored records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from Pressmark's external feedback service without writing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Produces a new PDF artifact from the supplied document; does not modify stored records or external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns the converted document without deleting or overwriting the original.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access external web resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Produces a receipt PDF from supplied payment details; does not charge, verify, or move money and changes no stored records — each call renders a new receipt artifact.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a receipt without moving money or changing bank records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access external web resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends a feedback report to Pressmark's private inbox; each submission is a new external write.
justifications.destructive_justification: Sends a report without deleting or overwriting stored records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends the report to Pressmark's external feedback inbox.

positive_test_cases.description: Create and preview a sample consulting invoice. Use an unauthenticated Pressmark connection and the fictional party names in the prompt. Do not supply email addresses, a customer account, or a payment link. This setup avoids customer-record sync.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Create sample invoice INV-DEMO-0043, issued October 29, 2026, from Sample Studio to Sample Client for 15 consulting hours at $250 in USD. Show its preview and PDF download link. Do not include emails or a payment link.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Call generate_document and preview_document with doc_type='invoice', doc_number='INV-DEMO-0043', issue_date='2026-10-29', from.name='Sample Studio', to.name='Sample Client', currency='USD', and one item with quantity=15 and unit_price=250. Show the invoice summary and PNG preview with the supplied number, date, and $3,750 total. Show the returned PDF download link and open it before expiry to verify the PDF has those same fields. Explain that the link expires in 15 minutes, may stop working sooner after a service restart, and can be opened by anyone who has it. Do not claim legal certification.

positive_test_cases.description: Calculate a sample invoice total with tax and a discount.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: For a sample USD invoice from Sample Studio to Sample Client, calculate three laptops at $1,200 each with 9.25% sales tax and a $150 discount.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Call calculate_totals with the named parties, quantity 3, unit price 1200, tax rate 9.25, and discount amount 150. Show a $3,600 subtotal, $333 tax, $150 discount, and $3,783 total and balance due.

positive_test_cases.description: Convert a complete sample estimate into an invoice. The prompt supplies the document content; the app is not expected to retrieve a stored estimate by number. Use the returned document date for the 30-day due-date check.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Convert this sample estimate to an invoice due in 30 days: EST-DEMO-0042, from Sample Studio to Sample Client, USD, one Mobile app design item at $5,000. Do not add emails or a payment link.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Call convert_document with target_type='invoice', due_days=30, and document containing doc_type='estimate', doc_number='EST-DEMO-0042', the named parties, currency='USD', and one item with quantity=1 and unit_price=5000. Show the returned PDF link and invoice summary with total $5,000, pending payment status, and number INV-DEMO-0042. Conversion sets the issue date to the execution date in UTC and the due date 30 days later. Verify those dates in the returned document or PDF. Do not claim a saved accounting record was updated.

positive_test_cases.description: Show a partial-payment invoice using an explicitly fictional payment. The app calculates from the supplied data; it does not verify a bank or payment-provider transaction or update a stored ledger.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Use this sample invoice: INV-DEMO-0043, issued October 28, 2026, from Sample Studio to Sample Client, USD, 15 consulting hours at $250. For a fictional $1,000 payment on October 28, 2026, method Sample payment, reference DEMO-PAYMENT-001, show the remaining balance. Do not charge anyone.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Call record_payment with the complete invoice document, amount_paid=1000, paid_date='2026-10-28', payment_method='Sample payment', and transaction_reference='DEMO-PAYMENT-001'. Show the returned PDF link and partial-payment status, total $3,750, amount paid $1,000, and balance due $2,750. Explain that the result reflects the supplied sample payment. Do not claim money moved, a transaction was verified, or a customer record was saved.

positive_test_cases.description: Produce a receipt from a complete sample invoice and an explicitly fictional full payment. Run independently of the partial-payment case so the input still has no prior payment.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a sample receipt for invoice INV-DEMO-0043, issued October 28, 2026, from Sample Studio to Sample Client, USD, 15 consulting hours at $250. The fictional payment is $3,750 on October 28, 2026, method Sample payment, reference DEMO-PAYMENT-002. Do not charge anyone.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Call record_payment with the complete invoice document, amount_paid=3750, paid_date='2026-10-28', payment_method='Sample payment', and transaction_reference='DEMO-PAYMENT-002'. Show the returned PDF link and receipt REC-DEMO-0043 with paid-in-full status, amount paid $3,750, and zero balance. Verify the supplied date and reference in the returned document or PDF. Explain that the receipt reflects user-supplied sample details; do not claim payment-provider verification or ledger persistence.

negative_test_cases.description: Pressmark does not upgrade accounts or start checkout from chat. Do not invoke a document tool, show a subscription catalog, or return a checkout link.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Upgrade my Pressmark account to a paid plan and send me the checkout link.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Pressmark does not upgrade accounts or start checkout from chat. Do not invoke a document tool, show a subscription catalog, or return a checkout link.

negative_test_cases.description: Collecting money or charging a saved card is outside the app's document tools. Do not invoke Pressmark tools. Explain that a payment provider must process the charge and that creating a receipt would not prove payment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Charge my client's saved card $3,750 now and confirm the money reached my bank account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Collecting money or charging a saved card is outside the app's document tools. Do not invoke Pressmark tools. Explain that a payment provider must process the charge and that creating a receipt would not prove payment.

negative_test_cases.description: The app has no direct email-sending tool. Do not invoke generate_document or other Pressmark tools as a substitute for sending a reminder. Explain the limit and offer to draft reminder wording in the conversation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use only Pressmark for this request, without Gmail or any other app: email the invoice to my client now and schedule daily payment reminders from my mailbox. Can Pressmark itself do that?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app has no direct email-sending tool. Do not invoke generate_document or other Pressmark tools as a substitute for sending a reminder. Explain the limit and offer to draft reminder wording in the conversation.

review_instructions.test_account_credentials: Document generation is available without credentials. Use a guest session and synthetic sender and recipient details for review. A configured customer sync can use the signed-in email, otherwise the sender email, then the recipient email.
review_instructions.data_safety_attestation: Pressmark processes document details to render PDFs and previews. It retains account, billing, and usage records. When customer sync is enabled, it sends contact details, document summaries, and activity records to HighLevel and can start follow-up workflows. The document-generation sync does not send the PDF or line-item descriptions. See https://pressmark.dev/privacy.
